question: Which divine qualities identify the goddess who presides over the great Śrīcakra?
premises: The goddess is beloved as devotees' life.
She is the mistress of the great Śrīcakra.
Both epithets describe the same deity.
inference: The goddess is identified as the devotee-beloved mistress of the great Śrīcakra.
plain_english: The goddess, beloved as the very life of devotees, is the mistress of the great Śrīcakra.
